title: Net Energy Metering Agreement Terms — Modification, Transfer on Sale and Termination
content:
## Terms in force

**Modification.** An operating Net Energy Metering agreement may increase its capacity by no more than the rider's modification limit, as a fraction of the approved capacity, through a modification, within the rider's size limits. A larger increase requires a new application under the rider then open, and under a rider whose modifications lose grandfathering any increase does. Modifications are made only on an agreement in operating status.

**Transfer on sale.** When the premises are sold and the rider allows transfer on sale, the agreement moves to the buyer's service agreement at the same address once the buyer has started service. The seller's bank is settled under the rider's disposition on sale before the move, and the true-up month is unchanged.

**Termination.** Termination is the customer's decision, or follows the closure of the service agreement when no transfer applies.

**Clause no longer in force.** The clause providing that the bank is then settled under the rider's termination disposition is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current termination settlement basis.

The status of the agreement is read from the company's records before a modification or a transfer is made; only an agreement in operating status qualifies for either.

## Capacity increases (hypothetical approved capacity of 10.0 kW AC, modification limit of 10 percent)

| New capacity | Rider whose modifications do not lose grandfathering | Rider whose modifications lose grandfathering |
|---|---|---|
| 11.0 kW AC | Modification, provided it stays within the rider's size limits | New application under the rider then open |
| 11.1 kW AC | New application under the rider then open | New application under the rider then open |

## Transfer on sale at a glance

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Who receives the agreement | The buyer, on the buyer's service agreement at the same address |
| When | Once the buyer has started service |
| Seller's bank | Settled under the rider's disposition on sale, before the move |
| True-up month | Unchanged |

superseded_clauses: the bank is then settled under termination_disposition.
